observations: WP-12dl / WP-S2c-75 is the H-003 combined R1+R2 cycle 1 evidence package. It uses existing committed EXP-0004 and creates REP-0028, one trial-log row, OL-0028, and two separate RECs from OL-0028 for d2_006_gates and exp_success_criteria. The WP-12dl window is the final local data-year window, 2025-04-12 through 2026-04-11, with indicator warmup from earlier available 1d history and no pre-window position carry-in. The bounded run produced positive OOS Sharpe but negative total PnL, failed 4 of 8 D2-006 gates, and preserved gross-PnL-negative cost-drag as undefined/misleading rather than healthy cost behavior. The schema-required next_step_recommendation field carries no policy, promotion, ranking, paper/live, runtime, protected-path, or downstream authority.
diagnostic_findings: REP-0028 is one genuine local research evaluation with a new trial id against existing EXP-0004; no new EXP was created.
The selected exact segments are H-003 / research_oos / pre_wp_5b / d2_006_gates and H-003 / research_oos / pre_wp_5b / exp_success_criteria.
The evaluation window is explicit and non-cloned: 2025-04-12 through 2026-04-11, with 365 1d bars from 2025-04-12 23:59:59.999000+00:00 through 2026-04-11 23:59:59.999000+00:00.
Indicators were warmed up on earlier available local 1d history, and the backtest window started flat with no inherited pre-window position carry-in.

The original H-003 REP-0004 evidence used a full-period no-formal-split retrospective baseline, so strict non-overlap against existing committed H-003 evidence is impossible; this report records that limitation explicitly.
The run did not liquidate but recorded max_drawdown = 0.9387065478299754 and final_equity = 7849.724492290963 under current WP-5b bounded-equity semantics.

The source REP/OL chain is intentionally reused for two separate RECs under approved R1 paired-source reuse and approved R2 batched-cycle methodology; the two RECs preserve separate expectation-source comparisons and exact-segment counts.

The next_step_recommendation field is schema-required only and has no policy, scoring, ranking/recommendation, paper/live, runtime, promotion, demotion, readiness, lifecycle, protected-path, or downstream authority.
The run creates no H-003 completion, A2C-002 completion, Path B, Phase 3, runtime behavior, or protected-path authority.
